summary: Regression pass after backend was split into routes/ package + new GET /api/auth/session endpoint. Backend pytest suite: 20/20 pass (18 original + 2 new session tests added). Frontend: verified /api/auth/session returns 200 on every public route (Landing, /login, /register, /forgot-password, /terms, /privacy) — zero 401 network entries as intended. Login->dashboard works, all 8 dashboard sub-routes render clean, resume create + autosave (PUT /api/resumes/:id) fires and returns 200, ATS analyze returns 200 with valid score+matched+missing shape. Logout redirects to /login and session silently returns null on next hydration.
critical_code_review_comments: Router split is clean — server.py now ~110 lines, each route module is focused. No mounting bugs; every endpoint reachable under /api prefix.
get_current_user_optional in deps.py correctly returns None on missing/invalid token (no 401 leakage into /auth/session).
@app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated in newer FastAPI — consider migrating to lifespan context manager (non-blocking).
seed_data_creation: Test-created a resume + ATS scan under test@careerforge.ai (TEST_ prefix on titles).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend now modular under /app/backend/routes/. Add new endpoints as routes/<feature>.py and include_router in server.py. /api/auth/session is the SPA hydration endpoint (always 200); /api/auth/me still strict-401 (legacy, tested). Backend suite ~65s with 2 workers.
